_readme: Example only (a made-up lawn care company). Copy to the project's deliverables/owner-sheet/src/ folder. Part 1 comes from packages.md, part 2 from the ask-first list and the recommended design, part 3 from the setup-list in plain words. Twelve numbered items at most. Every tick question that can have one carries a default: the option that claims nothing new. The builder checks each suggested price and sets decide_by before it goes out.
subject: Owner sheet
title: The last things we need from you
intro: Ana, this is everything still open on the site, on one sheet. Most of it is a tick. Skip what you're not sure about and we'll go with the line under the question.

questions.title: What you sell
questions.text: This is how the site will describe your services. Change any price, or leave the line blank to keep ours. The prices are in line with what two other crews in town publish.

questions.decides: the monthly plans and their prices

rows.label: Every two weeks
rows.detail: Mowing, edging and blowing off the walks

rows.label: Every week
rows.detail: The same, plus beds weeded once a month

questions.decides: the one-time jobs and their prices

rows.label: Yard cleanup
rows.detail: Overgrown yards, hauled away the same day

rows.label: New sod
rows.detail: Measured and quoted on a visit

questions.prompt: Should the site show these prices?

options.label: Show only where each one starts
No prices. List what's in each and let them ask for a quote

questions.title: The website
questions.text: We'd go with the bright one with your truck up top: you said your customers are older and want it easy to read.

options.label: Yes, but change one thing (write it below)
No, I want to see a different one

questions.decides: what the first screen leads with
questions.prompt: You said the other crew's site looks "more professional." What makes it look that way to you?

options.label: It shows finished yards, before and after
It shows their license and reviews

questions.decides: whether customers are named on the site
questions.prompt: Can the site show the street or the neighborhood of a finished yard?

options.label: No. Show the yard and nothing else

questions.prompt: When someone asks for a quote, who gets it? Write the email and the phone number.

questions.decides: whether a phone and email show on the site
questions.prompt: Should that phone number show on the site?

options.label: Yes, with a button to call
Not yet, the quote form only

questions.decides: whether the owner appears on the site
questions.prompt: A photo of you and the crew on the site?

options.label: No, keep it about the yards
